title: Taobao & Tmall scrape results
description: Dataset of product, shop and listing records, plus run summary and debug probe records in the default key-value store.

dataset.title: Results
dataset.description: Default dataset items: product details, search listings and shop catalogue rows.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: RUN_SUMMARY record: counts, billing, proxy country, translation status and any block warnings. Written on every run, including timeouts and aborts.

debugProbe.title: Debug probe
debugProbe.description: DEBUG_PROBE record: redacted request telemetry (URLs, status codes, cookie names only). Written on every run.

blockedRunNote.title: Blocked-run note
blockedRunNote.description: BLOCKED_RUN_NOTE record, written only when a run returns zero products because of anti-bot blocks.
